Cusack Music Mojo Hand FX browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Mojo Hand FX Bluebonnet - Overdrive Published on June 19, 2012 Mojo Hand FX overdrive pedal preview preview Special Special Special Special Special Special Information The Mojo Hand FX Bluebonnet is an overdrive pedal inspired by classic Texas blues and rock tones, designed as a straightforward yet powerful dirt box. The original version featured a minimalist two-knob layout with only Volume and Gain controls, offering a balanced voicing that sits naturally with an amplifier. With no EQ or tone shaping, it was deliberately tuned to remain smooth, neutral, and free from excessive brightness, muddiness, or nasal midrange emphasis. This version excels as a grab-and-go overdrive for boosting a clean amp, pushing an already overdriven amp harder, or serving as a foundation for stacking with other pedals. A later variant, the Bluebonnet Special , expanded the design into a three-knob format with the addition of a Tone control and a two-way toggle for selecting between different clipping styles. This provided more tonal flexibility and a wider gain range, extending from medium overdrive into higher-gain saturation with a rougher edge. The Special version was often described as favoring raunchier, Billy Gibbons-inspired drive textures rather than smoother Stevie Ray Vaughan-style voicing. Both versions retain a simple, intuitive control set that makes them easy to dial in while delivering a range of amp-like drive tones. Controls Original Bluebonnet (2-knob version): Volume: output level Gain: sets drive amount Bluebonnet Special (3-knob version): Volume: output level Gain: sets drive amount Tone: adjusts overall brightness and EQ balance Clipping toggle: selects between two clipping styles Connections Input jack Output jack Power input (standard 9V DC, center negative) Highlights Original version: streamlined two-control design voiced for balance and simplicity Special version: expanded with Tone control and clipping toggle for added versatility Medium to high gain overdrive with Texas blues-inspired character Works as a clean boost, main overdrive, or stacked with other pedals Amp-like response with a focus on touch dynamics and harmonic richness Video Date ▼▲ Maker ▼▲ Video ▼▲ Time ▼▲ 2018-0

The Bluebonnet strips overdrive down to essentials: Volume and Gain. Named for Texas's state flower, this pedal delivers Lone Star tone without the complexity of EQ controls. Mojo Hand voiced it relatively flat—not too bright, not too dark, no 'honky' mids. This streamlined approach puts all focus on the core overdrive character. The flat frequency response means the Bluebonnet responds naturally to your guitar's tone controls and amp settings, rather than imposing its own EQ curve. Medium gain range with straightforward dynamics. True bypass switching in die-cast enclosure with Neutrik jacks. For players who want Texas overdrive character without endless tweaking—plug in, set gain and volume, done. Demo Videos Specifications No specifications available. sources.excerpt: Bluebonnet by Mojo Hand Fx | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Mojo Hand Fx Bluebonnet LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS EQUALIZER OVERDRIVE BOOSTER Description Sweet Texas Heat… The Bluebonnet is a streamlined, straight to the point tribute to Lone Star Tone. Designed to be the ultimate grab-n-go dirt pedal, its simplistic dual control layout (Volume and Gain) makes it a natural extension of your amp. Crank the Volume knob to give your rig a boot to the tubes, or dime the Gain and watch your licks scorch like the sun on a summer day in Dallas. With no Tone or EQ controls, we’ve voiced the Bluebonnet relatively flat: not too bright, not too dark, no ‘honky’ mids…just nice, smooth and neutral. While the Bluebonnet’s design favors simplicity over versatility, thats not to say its a mere one trick pony. Whether its used to add some grit to a clean amp, kick an already overdriven amp to the next level, or used as a base tone to stack other pedals…the Bluebonnet delivers classic shades of drive smothered in Tejas Mojo.^ Media Videos Demo by Visual Guy (EN) Demo by Lance Seymour (EN) Reviews Review by The Gear Page (EN) Review by TDPRI (EN) Links Official Website Technical data Width 000.00 mm Depth 000.00 mm Height 000.00 mm Weight 000.00 mm Circuit type analog Voltage 9V DC, center negative Current 39mA More pedals from Mojo Hand Fx OVERDRIVE OVERDRIVE Mojo Hand Fx Rock City FUZZ FILTER FUZZ FILTER Mojo Hand Fx 1979 TREMOLO BOOSTER TREMOLO BOOSTER Mojo Hand Fx Bayou FUZZ DISTORTION FUZZ DISTORTION Mojo Hand Fx BMP 2 All Mojo Hand Fx Pedals Products Pedalboards All-In-One Patchbays QuickMount PedalSafe Power Supplies and Power Cables and Connections Accessories Gear Build your own board Board Configurator PedalPedia Pedalboard Gallery QuickMount Finder Services Find a dealer Find a distributor Frequently Asked Questions Contact Current catalog News Community RockBoard Artists Achievements Your Activity Overview ©2026 Warwick GmbH & Co.
